components.name: Follow Button

components.name: Ink Pill

components.name: Author Bar

components.css: .ds-authorbar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; height: 56px; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--bg, #ffffff); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #e7e7e3); font-family: var(--font-golos, 'Golos Text'), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-authorbar-id { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: var(--ink, #1d1d1b); text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-authorbar-av { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #e9dccb; color: #2b2b28; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-authorbar-follow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--accent, #1a7f37); color: var(--on-accent, #ffffff); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: filter 150ms ease-out; } .ds-authorbar-follow:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-authorbar-id:focus-visible, .ds-authorbar-follow:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #1a7f37); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-thumbs { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 4px; } .ds-thumb { width: 64px; height: 64px; flex-shrink: 0; border: 0; padding: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #c9b79a, #6f8a9c); cursor: pointer; filter: brightness(0.88) saturate(0.55); transition: filter 150ms ease-out; } .ds-thumb:hover { filter: none; } .ds-thumb[aria-current='true'] { filter: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--bg, #ffffff), 0 0 0 4px var(--ink, #1d1d1b); } .ds-thumb:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #1a7f37); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Author's Front Page"**

A reading site built to the Substack and Medium bar and executed straight: white paper (or a true near-black at night), near-black ink, one green that only ever means "follow" or "go". The author's name, face and writing lead every screen; the platform shows itself only in a footer line. Nothing is a card. Posts are rows of type separated by hairlines, the reading body is a 20px serif at a 680px measure, and everything that is not reading (titles, bars, meta, buttons) speaks in one neutral sans.

Density is calm and editorial: generous vertical rhythm between feed rows, slim 56px bars, centred profile blocks, and media that is allowed to be wider than the text column (960px) without ever going full-bleed on desktop. A two-line note, a 20-photo album and a 5,000-word article all sit in the same feed grammar and each looks intended. Cyrillic, Uzbek Latin (with the U+02BB okina) and English share one voice; every face is chosen and patched so the three scripts look equally designed.

The world refuses the generic content template: no same-size thumbnail cards, no gradient heroes, no decorative colour. Light is the default and dark follows the reader's system setting, with every token redefined rather than inverted.
keyCharacteristics: White and true-dark pages, near-black ink, a single green accent.
Serif for reading, neutral sans for everything else.
Hairline dividers between rows; no cards, no surface shadows.
Round avatars as the author's mark; pill buttons only for small actions.
Media may run wider than the text measure; the measure itself never exceeds 680px.
One primary call to action per region: follow the author's Telegram channel.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Green means "follow" or "go" and nothing else. It never fills a surface, a badge or a heading, and an author home carries exactly one green pill (the bar's Follow); the channel handle in the profile block is a green text link, not a second pill.

rules.name: The Redefine-Don't-Invert Rule
rules.body: Dark mode re-declares every token under `prefers-color-scheme: dark` with its own tuned value; nothing is produced by filters or opacity flips, and the browser theme colour follows the same two page values.

rules.name: The Serif-Reads, Sans-Speaks Rule
rules.body: Literata is for text a reader reads as the author's: the prose body, bios, ledes and the featured excerpt. Everything structural (titles, headings inside prose, bars, meta, buttons, captions, tables) is Golos. Feed-row excerpts stay sans and muted so the list scans.

rules.name: The Balanced Title Rule
rules.body: Every title is 700 weight, -0.021em tracking, `text-wrap: balance` and `overflow-wrap: anywhere`, because Telegram titles are a post's first line and can be long, chatty or one unbroken URL.

rules.name: The Okina Rule
rules.body: Literata ships U+02BB with zero advance width, so a local face (Literata Okina) that maps only U+02BB to Literata's own turned comma sits first in the serif stack, loaded by unicode-range and never preloaded. Any face added to the system must cover Latin, Latin Extended and Cyrillic, and must render oʻ and gʻ with a real advance before it ships.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Rows, sections, bars and footers are separated by a 1px line in the line colour and by space, never by cards, fills or shadows.

rules.name: The Over-a-Photo Exception
rules.body: The only things allowed to float are controls and badges laid over imagery: the gallery arrows (page-colour circle at 95% with the floating-control shadow) and the media badges and counter (black at 65% with white text).

rules.name: The Blockquote Rule
rules.body: A quotation in prose is set off by a 3px solid ink rule on its left, 1.1em of inner space, italic Literata in soft ink, and 1.6em of margin above and below. It is the prose's own quoting device and belongs to quoted text inside the article body.

rules.name: The Full-Colour Thumbnail Rule
rules.body: Inactive gallery thumbnails are never faded with opacity; they are dimmed and desaturated so every photo stays legible and the active ring is the only state marker.

dos: Do give every author space the author bar, with their avatar and name on the left and one Follow pill on the right.
Do separate feed items with 1px hairlines and 28px of vertical space, and keep every post type (note, album, video, long read) in the same Post Row grammar.
Do set reading text in Literata at 1.125rem (1.25rem from 640px) on a 680px measure, and everything structural in Golos Text.
Do let covers, albums and video widen to 960px while the text stays at 680px.
Do carry dates, read times and counts in the muted meta line with tabular figures and centred-dot separators.
Do redefine every colour token for dark mode and check both themes.
Do test new type against Cyrillic, Uzbek Latin with oʻ and gʻ, and English in the same view.
donts: Don't put posts in cards, tiles or shadowed boxes, or show a grid of same-size thumbnail cards.
Don't use the green accent for decoration, headings, badges or fills beyond the Follow pill, links, focus and selection.
Don't add a second green pill to a region that already has one; the author home's channel handle is a text link.
Don't cast shadows on content; the floating-control shadow belongs only to controls laid over photos.
Don't fade inactive gallery thumbnails with opacity.
Don't let the platform's name or branding appear in an author's bar or profile block; it lives in the footer line.
Don't invent author names, follower counts, view counts or testimonials on shipped pages.
